Daily Water Intake Calculator

Get a personalized daily hydration target in liters, glasses and fluid ounces from your weight and activity.

–

–

–

Guideline only — food provides water too. On very hot or hard-training days, drink to thirst.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your body weight in kg.
  2. Choose your activity level.
  3. Toggle hot climate if it applies.
  4. Read your target in liters, 250 ml glasses and fluid ounces.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the target calculated?

It starts at 35 ml per kg of body weight, then adds water for activity level and hot climates. It is a widely used guideline, not a medical prescription.

What does the hot-climate toggle add?

The toggle adds a flat 500 ml, roughly what extra sweating in heat costs. On very hot or very active days you may need more — drink to thirst and watch urine color.

Does food count toward the target?

Food also provides water (often 20–30% of intake), so the target covers total water needs, not just what you drink.
